questions.stem: My brother doesn’t like playing ________ chess. He likes playing ________ football.
questions.expl: 句意：我弟弟不喜欢下棋，他喜欢踢足球。 考查冠词用法。动词play 与棋类或球类名词连用时，名词前不用冠词，因此空一处是play chess“下 棋”；空二处是play football“踢足球”。故选D。

questions.stem: You can use my bike if you promise ________ it back tomorrow afternoon.
questions.expl: 句意：你可以使用我的自行车，如果你承诺明天下午把它还给我。 考查动词不定式。promise to do sth.承诺做某事。根据句意可知，这是是承诺归还自行车。故选B。

questions.stem: —Do you agree _______ me?—Yes, I do. I will try to eat more fruit and vegetables. They are good _______ my health.
questions.expl: 句意：——你同意我的看法吗？——是的，我同意。我会尽量多吃水果和蔬菜。它们对我 的健康有好处。 考查介词辨析。with 和……一起；for 对于；at 在；to 关于。根据句意可知，上句询问“你同意我的 看法吗”，agree with 表示“同意”，故第一空应用with；下句空格处需表示“对健康有好处”，“be good for …”表示“对……有好处”，故第二空应用for。故选A。

questions.stem: —Mr. Green, can you ________ some questions?—Sorry, I’m busy. I can’t ________ them.
questions.expl: 句意：——格林先生，你能回答一些问题吗？——对不起，我很忙。我无法回答它们。 考查动词辨析。answer“回答”，及物动词，后可直接加宾语，不需要添加介词to，排除A；reply“回 复”，不及物动词，后不可直接加宾语；reply to sb/sth “对……作出回复”。第一划线处后面有宾语 some questions，需用及物动词answer 或reply to；排除C、D。故选B。

questions.stem: The officer ordered his men ________ the people in the city.
questions.expl: 句意：这个军官命令他的手下保护这个城市的人们。 考查动词不定式。order sb. to do sth.“命令某人做某事”，protect“保护”，故用动词不定式形式。故选 B。

questions.stem: The students want to challenge ______.
questions.expl: C 本题考查代词辨析。这些学生们想挑战他们自己。A. them 是宾格人称代词；B. they 是 人称代词主格；C. themselves 是反身代词，意为他们自己；D. himself 他自己，是反身代词。短语 challenge oneself 意为挑战某人自己，根据主语students 是复数可知，反身代词用themselves。故选 C。

questions.stem: I received a beautiful dress on my________ birthday. I like it very much.
questions.expl: 句意：在我12 岁生日的时候，我收到了一件美丽的裙子，我非常喜欢它。 考查数词。twelve 十二，基数词；twelveth 形式错误；the twelfth 第十二，序数词，前面用定冠词 the；twelfth 第十二，序数词。表示“……岁生日”，应用序数词，先排除A 和B；空前有了限定词 my，因此不用定冠词the，C 不对。故选D。

questions.stem: A _______ boy can sing the English song very well.
questions.expl: 句意：一个十岁的男孩能唱好这首英文歌。 考查年龄表达法。英语中用“基数词-year-old”表示年龄，此结构常做(前置)定语；“基数词+ years old” 用作表语。本句名词boy 需用限定词修饰，根据句意结构，可知选A。 【点睛】表示“某人几岁”的确切年龄，用“基数词＋years old”或“基数词＋of age”或者“at the age of ＋基数词”，也可直接用基数词。

questions.stem: More than ________ people died in the war between the two countries two years ago.
questions.expl: 句意：如果你同意我们的观点，请举手。 考查连词辨析。unless 除非；if 如果；although 尽管；before 在……之前。分析句子结构可知，从 句是主句动作发生的条件，即“举手”的前提是“同意”，应用if 引导条件状语从句。故选B。

questions.stem: Please raise your hand ________ you agree with us.
questions.expl: 句意：相反，他有必要参加会议。instead 可以放于句首，用逗号隔开；instead of 是介宾 短语，后面常接宾语，首先排除A,C；It’s +adj.+ for sb. to do sth.做某事对于某人来说怎么样，故答 案为B。

questions.stem: ________, it is necessary for him ________ the meeting.
questions.expl: 句意：——南通的市花是什么？——菊花。它象征着和平、高尚等等。人们喜欢在重阳节 前后欣赏它们。 考查介词短语。a symbol of……的象征；a list of 一系列的；a cycle of……的周期；a sense of 一种…… 的感觉。根据“Chrysanthemum. It’s... peace, nobility (高尚) and so on”可知，是指菊花是和平、高尚 等的象征。故选A。

questions.stem: —What’s the city flower of Nantong?―Chrysanthemum. It’s ________ peace, nobility (高尚) and so on. And people like to enjoy them aroundDouble Ninth Festival.
questions.expl: 句意：这个食谱中的糖太多了。 考查短语辨析。A number of 许多；The amount of………的数量，后接不可数名词；The number of…… 的数量，后常接可数名词的复数形式；A large amount of 大量的。根据句意可知，此处指数量， sugar“糖”，此时为不可数名词。故选B。

questions.stem: Some rules are almost the same _______in the world, but rules of etiquette can be different fromplace to place．
questions.expl: 句意：第二次世界大战发生在20 世纪40 年代。 考查年代表达。根据常识可知，第二次世界大战发生在20 世纪40 年代，表示在某个世纪的几十年 代，用“in the +逢十的基数词的复数”，基数词的复数若用阿拉伯数字表示，可直接加s，也可加’s。 故选A。 二、完形填空(本大题共10 小题，每小题1 分，满分10 分) In foreign countries, some people do not like the number 13. They don’t think 13 is a 16 number. For 17, they don’t like to live on the thirteenth floor. My friend Jack has got the same 18. He doesn’t like the number 13, either. One day he 19 some friends to dinner. When 20 of his friends arrived, he asked them to sit around the table. He began to count the people in his mind when they were 21 the delicious food. Suddenly (突然) he cried out, “Oh, there are thirteen people here!” Everybody’s face turned 22 except (除了……之外) Mr. Brown. He said 23 with a smile on his face, “Don’ t worry, my dear friends! We have 24 people here. My wife, Mrs. Brown, will have a 25 in a few weeks. She is in the family way now.” All of them became happy again. “Congratulations (祝贺)!” they said to Mr. and Mrs. Brown. They enjoyed the nice food and had a good time that evening.

questions.stem: A．lucky
questions.expl: ：他们认为13 不是一个幸运数字。 lucky 幸运的；happy 开心的；big 大的；special 特别的。根据“In foreign countries, some people do not like the number 13.”可知，认为13 不是一个幸运数字。故选A。

questions.stem: A．care
questions.expl: ：例如，他们不喜欢住在13 楼。 care 关心；example 例子；long 长的；sure 确定的。“For example”为固定短语，意为“例如”，故选 B。 18．句意：我的朋友Jack 也有同样的想法。 idea 想法；way 方法；situation 情况；problem 问题。在此处表示Jack 也有不喜欢数字13 这个“想 法”。故选A。

questions.stem: A．idea
A．helped
questions.expl: ：有一天，他邀请了一些朋友来吃晚饭。 helped 帮助；found 发现；needed 需要；invited 邀请。根据“some friends to dinner”可知，表示“邀请 了一些朋友来吃晚饭”，故选D。

questions.stem: A．few
questions.expl: ：当他的全部朋友们都到了的时候，他让他们围着桌子坐下。 few 很少；some 一些；several 几个；all 全部。根据“he asked them to sit around the table. He began to count the people in his mind”可知，在此处表示“当他的朋友们都到了的时候”，故选D。

questions.stem: A．cooking
questions.expl: ：当他们正在享用美味的食物时，他开始在心里数人数。 cooking 烹饪；buying 购买；having 有，享用；sending 发送。“having the delicious food”表示“正在 享用美味的食物”。故选C。

questions.stem: A．red
questions.expl: ：除了Mr. Brown 之外，每个人的脸都变白了。 red 红色的；black 黑色的；white 白色的；green 绿色的。根据“Oh, there are thirteen people here!”可 知，大家对于这个数字感到不吉利，因此是脸变白，故选C。

questions.stem: A．slowly
questions.expl: ：他面带微笑慢慢地说。 slowly 慢慢地；strangely 奇怪地；angrily 生气地；unluckily 不幸地。根据“with a smile on his face” 可知，表示说话者的态度是轻松、愉快的，因此应该选择描述积极、正面态度的副词，即面带微笑 慢慢地说。故选A。

questions.stem: A．twelve
questions.expl: ：我们这里有14 个人。 twelve 12；thirteen 13；fourteen 14；fifteen 15。根据上文Jack 数出的人数是13，但接下来的话暗 示了他要有孩子了，因此总共是14 个人，故选C。

questions.stem: A．friend
questions.expl: ：我的妻子，Mrs. Brown，几周后就会有一个孩子。 friend 朋友；guest 客人；baby 孩子；mother 母亲。根据“She is in the family way now.”可知，在此 处表示Mrs. Brown 即将有一个孩子出生，故选C。

questions.stem: What can people use numbers to do EXCEPT?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“They are basic elements (元素) of mathematics for counting, measuring, and solving equations (方程).”可知人们可以用数字数数、测量、计算和解方程，不包括去旅行。故选D。

questions.stem: How old was Henry VI when he became King of England?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“It was the age of Henry VI (亨利六世) when he became King of England (he was nine months old).”可知亨利六世在九个月大的时候成为了英国的国王。故选C。

questions.stem: What can we know about Three and Seven?
opts: Three is unlucky in some cultures.
Seven is bad luck in Vietnam.
Seven sometimes appear in our lives.
People can survive 3 weeks without water.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Three is a creepy number in some cultures. In Vietnam, it’s bad luck to have three people in a photo as the one in the middle might die.”可知数字3 在一些国家代表不幸。故选A。

questions.stem: How much sleep does a child need every night?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Human children need around 10 hours of sleep a night (you’d need two hours if you were a giraffe and twenty-two hours if you were a koala).”可知一个小孩每晚需要睡十个小时。故 选B。 30．推理判断题。本文主要介绍了数字的有趣事实，因此可能在数学博客上读到此文章。故选C。

questions.stem: Where can we probably read this article?
Who are the first two books for?
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“It is a children’s picture book…”和“It makes counting from one to ten an exciting surprise.”可知，第一本书是儿童的图画书，第二本书能学习从一数到十，由以上可知这两本书都是 给孩子们看的。故选C。

questions.stem: Which words should you NOT use to describe (描述) All the Math You’ll Ever Need?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“All the Math You’ll Ever Need, the friendliest, funniest, and easiest counting program around.”可知，“The fastest”没有用来形容All the Math You’ll Ever Need 这本书。故选A。

questions.stem: Which is NOT true according to the passage?
opts: Ten, Nine, Eight is about counting numbers.
Danny later writes a book about counting numbers.
Steve Slavin needs a calculator to work out numbers.
Many students use Mastering Essential Math Skills each year.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“All the Math You’ll Ever Need by Steve Slavin”和“Are you tired of using a calculator to work out some numbers? Are you worried if it gives the wrong answer? Try the book All the Math You’ll Ever Need…”可知，想学习如何不使用计算器来计算一些数字应该看All the Math You’ll Ever Need 这本书，而这本书的作者是Steve Slavin，由此可知Steve Slavin 应该不需要计算器来计 算数字，选项C 的表达与原文不符。故选C。

questions.stem: What does the underlined word “it” refer to?
questions.expl: 猜测题。根据“Are you tired of using a calculator to work out some numbers? Are you worried if it gives the wrong answer?”可知，此处“it”指代上句的“calculator”，表达“担心计算器给出错误的答案” 的意思。故选B。

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
opts: Four people who are good at Maths.
questions.expl: 大意题。通读全文可知，本文主要介绍了四本关于数学的书。故选D。
